"''Not really.''"
"''Yeah. Me either.|Landonis Balthazar Calrissian and Han Solo|}} This [[Gender|male]] individual was the '''father''' of [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]]. After asking [[Han Solo]] if he was close with his [[Ovan|old man]], Calrissian said that he wasn't close with his [[Parent|dad]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Lando_and_Dad.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lando Calrissian and father as seen in ''LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales'']] Landonis Balthazar Calrissian's father was first mentioned in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Star Wars'' Anthology]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. There were plans to include Lando's father earlier in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise when [[Samuel L. Jackson]] was slated to appear as Lando's father—then named '''Grando Calrissian'''—in the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], before signing to play [[Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu]] instead.[[Star Wars Insider 131|''Star Wars Insider'' 131]] In the ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales]]'' episode "[[Gambit on Geonosis]]," Lando hangs a photo of his father in the cockpit of the ''Millennium Falcon'' shortly before the [[Battle of Endor]].{{DroidTales|Gambit on Geonosis}} ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1stcm}} *[[Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation 4|''Solo: A Star Wars Story Adaptation'' 4]] {{Mo}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{DroidTales|Gambit on Geonosis}} {{1st}} {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Père de Landonis Balthazar Calrissian |ka=ლენდონის ბალთაზარ კალრისიანის მამა }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Calrissian, Landonis Balthazar's father}} [[Category:Calrissian family]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
